causal_footprint.independence: an edit to an instance away from the active datum does not change the step; an edit at it does (the represented execution family's mutation tests)
causal_footprint.not_delivered: an interacting instance with two loci of activity; the process has one
causal_footprint.reads: a firing reads the enablement self-instance and the operation edge at the active datum (Control.fire, Control.enabled)
causal_footprint.writes: active, tape, clock, fuel; the program is kept (Control.fire_ok)

classification: deterministic computation: the represented process observed at step scales, and the abstract inverse system mirrored

connected_experiment.bound: L <= 3 * count <= L + 2 for a tape of length L
connected_experiment.limit: the frequency count / L lies within 2 / (3 L) of 1 / 3 at every scale; the limiting value 1 / 3 is the rational the bound isolates, and precision e needs L >= 2 / (3 e)
connected_experiment.readout: the number of entries equal to datum 0 in the tape

limit.cofinal_rescaling: Limits.thread_even, Limits.even_thread: the even scales have the same threads
limit.construction: Limits.ofSeq; universal property Limits.ofSeq_toSeq and Limits.toSeq_ofSeq: the thread space is the sequence space; no choice or compactness is used
limit.stages: words of length n over the carrier (Limits.Stage)
limit.thread_space: compatible families at every scale (Limits.Compatible, Limits.Thread)
limit.topology: declared, not proved: the product of the discrete topologies on the finite stages; totally disconnected; not an interval, not a circle; none is claimed, and an interval would need an order or metric compatible with the stages and an identification of threads this family does not make

lost_fuel.repair: observe the fuel beside the tape; with the program, the active datum and the fuel the next observation is determined (Observe.next_active_det)

not_delivered: an interval, circle or integration theory: the limit is a totally disconnected thread space and a rational frequency with a bound
lifting the successor relation of a fork to threads: the deterministic runner stops at a fork
a general theorem that every realized tape is eventually periodic: the determinism of the next datum is proved, the eventual periodicity is computed over the declared class
a second locus of activity for causal independence between two processes

observation_system.bonding: forget the entries beyond the coarser length
observation_system.scale: the number of steps of the deterministic runner watched
observation_system.why: a step only appends (Control.fire_ok through Observe.next_tape)

shift.meaning: two words with one prefix of length 2 shift to different words: the entry beyond the observed boundary would have to be supplied (Limits.shift_not_local)

verdicts.class: every program on the recorded setting with at most one operation enabled per datum, from every datum
verdicts.injective: the observation at the scale of a tape's length is the tape itself: injective on tapes
verdicts.why_not_surjective: a realized tape is functional (equal entries have equal successors, Observe.next_active_det), so no thread with the prefix [0, 1, 0, 2] is realized; the full thread space contains it

which_threads.all_mathematical_sequences: the thread space is all of them (the construction is total)
which_threads.computably_presented: between the two; not characterised here
which_threads.process_generated: functional tapes — equal entries have equal successors (Observe.next_active_det) — hence eventually periodic on a finite carrier; a strict subset
